propositions: Replacing anthropic.AsyncAnthropic with a function-typed monkeypatch before pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic is first imported causes TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for | when the provider evaluates its runtime AsyncAnthropic | AsyncAnthropicBedrock TypeAlias.

Three test nodes in test_rp04_s4_llm_runtime_heldout.py (lines 41, 60, 125) use function-shaped test doubles instead of class-shaped ones, breaking the SDK symbol contract and preventing lazy provider import.

The defect is test isolation, not production auth validation; production behavior correctly validates auth before client construction and should raise a secret-free LLMConfigError regardless of import order.

Changing the three AsyncAnthropic monkeypatch doubles from functions to class-shaped doubles preserves fail-if-constructed tripwires while maintaining the SDK symbol contract and allowing lazy provider import to succeed.
